title: SRM Medical College Hosts AGE WELL INDIA National Geriatric Summit on Healthier Ageing
summary: The summit, organised by the Department of Community Medicine, focused on geriatric care in public health and medical education.
body_html:
Chennai, 24 October 2026: SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, through its Department of Community Medicine, inaugurated AGE WELL INDIA, a National Geriatric Summit on the theme "From Prevention to Policy: Building Healthier Ageing Systems".

The summit was inaugurated by Dr. Binod Kumar Patro, Director, National Institute of Health and Family Welfare (NIHFW), New Delhi, as Chief Guest, with Padma Shri Dr. V. S. Natarajan, Founder and Chairman, Dr. V. S. Natarajan Geriatric Foundation, as Guest of Honour.

It highlighted the growing importance of geriatric healthcare in public health and medical education, with a focus on prevention, comprehensive care for older adults, and the role of policy in building accessible ageing-care systems.

"Geriatric care is not just about addressing medical needs; it is about ensuring dignity in aging," said Prof. Dr. R. Jayanthi, Dean (Medical), SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre.

Dr. Patro said geriatric care must be integrated into primary healthcare, and that the insights from the summit "should translate into actionable policies to strengthen elderly care across India."

Dr. Natarajan called for stronger geriatric services, rehabilitation centres and the training of more geriatricians, so that older people can live "with dignity, independence and quality of life".
